scripts.predev: npm run build -w @l5sly/contracts && npm run build -w @l5sly/api
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @l5sly/api" "npm run dev -w @l5sly/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @l5sly/contracts && npm run build -w @l5sly/api && npm run build -w @l5sly/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @l5sly/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @l5sly/api && npm run typecheck -w @l5sly/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @l5sly/contracts && npm run test -w @l5sly/api && npm run test -w @l5sly/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
